morphology.pattern_note: di-...-kan构成被动动词，词根jelas的拼写保持不变；di-与动词连写。输入包将dijelaskan标作词根，此处按实际构词更正。

word_family.gloss: 清晰、明确的性质或程度

senses.zh_definition: 被解释、说明或阐明，使内容、原因或情况变得清楚。
senses.en_definition: To be explained, clarified, or set out so as to be understood.
senses.ms_definition: Diterangkan atau dihuraikan supaya menjadi jelas.
senses.nuances: 是menjelaskan的di-被动形式，可省略施事者，也可用oleh引出施事者。适用于说明规则、原因、概念或情况。形式本身不表示过去或完成，时态与完成意义由上下文或telah、sudah等表达。释义依据[DBP的jelas词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243492&keyword=jelas)，改写为被动形式。

senses.zh_definition: 债务、费用等被付清或结清；在相应语境中，也可指某项事务被办妥。
senses.en_definition: To be paid off or settled, especially of a debt or payment; also to be completed, of a task.
senses.ms_definition: Diselesaikan atau dibereskan, khususnya hutang atau pembayaran.
senses.nuances: 须由宾语或上下文判断：hutang dijelaskan表示债务被清偿，不只是债务情况被解释。付款通知中的bayaran perlu dijelaskan表示费用须缴清。此义依据[DBP的menjelaskan第二义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243492&keyword=jelas)，改写为被动形式。

collocations.en: the debt is paid off in full

dual_scenarios.ms: Prosedur permohonan telah dijelaskan secara terperinci oleh pegawai yang bertugas.
dual_scenarios.zh: 值班官员已详细说明申请程序。
dual_scenarios.en: The application procedure has been explained in detail by the officer on duty.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 同事确认会议内容
dual_scenarios.zh: 刚才都解释清楚了，对吧？
spoken_features: 句末kan用于向对方确认，相当于“对吧”。
口语中可保留完整被动形式dijelaskan，同时省略已知的施事者。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Prosedur tu dah dijelaskan tadi, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Prosedur itu sudah dijelaskan tadi, bukan?
messages.zh: 那个流程刚才已经解释过了，对吧？
messages.en: That procedure was explained earlier, right?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, cuma aku nak semak satu perkara je.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, cuma saya mahu menyemak satu perkara sahaja.
messages.zh: 对，我只是想再确认一件事。
messages.en: Yes, I just want to check one thing.

etymology.historical_story: Dijelaskan belongs to the Malay family built around jelas, meaning clear and, in another sense, settled or finished. Adding the passive prefix di- and suffix -kan produces a form used for both explanations and settled payments. This shared family helps explain why official correspondence can use the same verb for clarifying procedures and clearing debts. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243492&keyword=jelas).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按di–jelas–kan分三块记：jelas是“清楚”，di-提示“被”，合起来是“被说清楚”；遇到hutang或bayaran，则联想“账目结清”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 被动表达适合报告和公文，可把重点放在已经说明的事项上。对客户说Perkara ini telah dijelaskan可能显得生硬，可补上Saya sedia memberikan penjelasan lanjut，表示愿意进一步说明。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 解释义适用于教学、会议和行政沟通；结清义常见于账单和付款通知。正式文本使用telah或sudah，熟人聊天可用dah。
